pairs.subject: candidate-ai-disclosure-and-explanation
pairs.evidence: app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:348 The candidate status page suppresses decisions whose actor is unknown by rendering null, violating the requirement that attribution must explicitly fail to an undetermined state rather than being hidden.

techniques.evidence: app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:347 The renderer falls back to replacing underscores with spaces for unlabelled decision kinds instead of withholding them until reviewed copy is provided.

app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:387 The decision facts view emits the model's self-reported confidence scalar to the candidate, violating the rule that confidence is evidence about the model rather than decisive personal data.
app/status/[token]/page.tsx:13 ApplicationStatusPage is a post-submission status tracking view rather than an application form at the point of submission.
app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:417 The status page manages recording audio deletion rather than the derived inventory of held personal data, which is served via /api/data/[token].
app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:395 The page shows a passive text note telling the candidate to reply to any email, providing no interactive review request mechanism carrying the decision ID.
app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:348 When attribution is unknown, the component renders null, suppressing undetermined decisions rather than rendering an explicit unknown actor state.

declined.subject: candidate-ai-disclosure-and-explanation
declined.reason: Preconditions for candidate-ai-disclosure-and-explanation do not hold: decisions-screen-wave-logic consists of internal business logic and state machines for the operator/recruiter Decisions UI (screen-wave reducer machine, peer comparison ranking, recruiter compliance posture folding, queue loading, and review card parsing), containing no candidate-facing surfaces, public status tokens, or candidate-directed explanations. Per the seat rule that not-applicable is not accepted, this pair is declined.
